observed_original_abi.calling_convention_rationale: The complete body is two instructions: 0x00b3d240 `A1 C4 EA 67 01` MOV EAX,DS:[0x0167eac4] and 0x00b3d245 `C3` RET. That body discriminates no convention. It reads no register, so ECX -- the only register __thiscall could deliver a receiver in -- is never consumed; it contains no memory operand naming ESP or any stack displacement, so nothing is popped; and the terminal RET carries no immediate, so the callee cleans up 0 bytes. For a zero-parameter, bare-RET body all four x86-32 conventions (__cdecl, __stdcall, __thiscall, __fastcall) compile to byte-identical code: each pops nothing and consumes no register. The only convention-discriminating fact the body carries is 'the callee pops zero bytes', and that is equally true of __cdecl and of __stdcall with zero parameters. Naming any one of the four would be a claim the bytes at 0x00b3d240..0x00b3d245 do not carry, so calling_convention is null and the staging macro PKG_W2_00B3D240_CALL deliberately carries no convention token.
observed_original_abi.receiver_rationale: No register is read anywhere in the body at 0x00b3d240..0x00b3d245: the only instruction that touches a register is the A1 accumulator load, which WRITES EAX from memory and consumes nothing. A receiver is delivered in a register under __thiscall and __fastcall, so no register can be carrying one.
observed_original_abi.zero_parameters_corrobation: Corroborated from the far side of the call. At 0x00b19298/0x00b1929d/0x00b192a2 the sequence is CALL 0x00b3d280 / CALL 0x00b3d240 / MOV EDX,DWORD PTR [EAX]: nothing is pushed before the call and nothing adjusts ESP afterwards. At 0x00b19449/0x00b1944e/0x00b19453 the sequence is CALL 0x00b3d230 / CALL 0x00b3d240 / MOV EDX,DWORD PTR [EAX], again with nothing pushed and nothing cleaned. Both callers therefore pass zero stack words and expect zero callee cleanup.
observed_original_abi.return_type_rationale: At 0x00b3d240 the instruction `A1 C4 EA 67 01` is the x86-32 accumulator load: opcode A1 followed by a four-byte little-endian absolute address, writing the whole of EAX from the dword at 0x0167eac4. The decompilation of 0x00b3d240 agrees on the width and stops there: `undefined4 FUN_00b3d240(void) { return DAT_0167eac4; }`. No pointer type is asserted, even though callers dereference the result: 0x00b19453 is `MOV EDX,DWORD PTR [EAX]` and 0x00b19457/0x00b1945a then load `MOV EAX,DWORD PTR [EDX+0x34]` and `CALL EAX`. That is a fact about the CALLERS' use of the returned word, not about what the word denotes; the body proves a four-byte load and nothing more. The concrete type behind 0x0167eac4 is recorded as unknown.
observed_original_abi.return_semantics: The 4-byte word stored at the absolute address 0x0167eac4, returned whole in EAX. All 32 bits are meaningful: the load at 0x00b3d240 writes the full register, so no narrower or sign-extended return is consistent with the bytes.
observed_original_abi.ret_form_rationale: 0x00b3d245 is the single byte C3, a bare RET with no immediate operand. A RET with an immediate would be RET 0xN and would pop N bytes; this one pops nothing.
observed_original_abi.termination: RET at 0x00b3d245, five bytes after the entry at 0x00b3d240; it is the second and last instruction of the body.
observed_original_abi.stack_cleanup_rationale: 0x00b3d245 is a bare RET (C3) with no immediate, so the callee pops 0 bytes. The body neither pushes nor adjusts ESP, and no register is saved, so there is no frame to tear down: cleanup ownership is moot and 'none' is what the bytes carry.

notes: Authored from the machine, not from the briefing: the six bytes at 0x00b3d240..0x00b3d245, the 16-byte read at that address, the Ghidra function record, the segment table, the PE section table, the two call sites read live, and the two committed sidecar rows. The reconstruction is total for this body -- every instruction, operand, register and return of 0x00b3d240..0x00b3d245 is accounted for -- and nothing is asserted beyond it. Two decisions are worth flagging to the integrator. First, calling_convention is null, not a guess: a zero-parameter bare-RET body is byte-identical under __cdecl, __stdcall, __thiscall and __fastcall, and the staging macro therefore carries no convention token. Second, the return type is a bare 32-bit word: three call sites read the result as a pointer and one of them calls through it, but that is the callers' use of the value, and recording a pointer here would smuggle in a class, a vtable and a field layout that the machine does not show. name/normalized_symbol are the index record's own Ghidra placeholder FUN_00b3d240, since this VA has no SDK name and borrowing a neighbour's would be worse than admitting the gap.
